blocks.text:
## 2027 programme prices

Rates are in USD per person. BB means accommodation with breakfast. SGL means single occupancy, DBL double occupancy and TRP triple occupancy.

| Option | Hotels | SGL | DBL | TRP |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 5* | Bristol Panama Registy Collection, 3 nights + Gamboa Rainforest Resort, 2 nights; BB + services | 3,832 | 2,027 | 1,896 |
| 4* | Tryp By Wyndham Panama Centro, 3 nights + Gamboa Rainforest Resort, 2 nights; BB + services | 3,607 | 1,915 | 1,783 |

The 5* and 4* categories refer to the options in the capital; the separate category of Gamboa Rainforest Resort is confirmed when booking.

## Accommodation and meals

The first two nights are spent in Panama City, the third and fourth in Gamboa, and the fifth back in Panama City. This totals 3 nights in the capital and 2 nights in Gamboa.

From Day 2 to Day 6, each day begins with breakfast at the hotel. Lunch is mentioned in the descriptions of Days 2 and 3. The rate table specifies BB, while the general list of services refers to meals as per the itinerary: whether lunches are included and their payment terms are confirmed when booking. No dinners are specified in the daily programme.

## Guide and transfer services

Meet-and-greet services and transfers are private. A guide accompanies you throughout your stay in Panama. Standard guided services are in English; English- or Portuguese-language service is agreed separately. The specific language, its terms and the applicable rate are confirmed when booking.
